market_question: Will Justin Thomas win the 2026 PGA Championship?
reasoning: Justin Thomas is a two-time PGA Championship winner and a top-30 player, giving him a significantly higher chance to win the 2026 PGA than the market's implied 0.3%. Historical major championship odds for players of his caliber typically range 2-4%, and betting markets often price him around +3000 to +4000. The current price of 0.3% appears to be an anomaly, likely due to limited market attention.
evidence_points: Justin Thomas won the PGA Championship in 2017 and 2022, demonstrating course compatibility.
Top-30 world ranking and major pedigree imply a realistic 2-4% win probability each year.
Current betting odds at major sportsbooks place him in the +3000 to +4000 range, equivalent to ~2.4-3.2% probability.
